description: XPath 1.0 3.7: '*' is the multiply operator after an operand (number, name, ')' or ']') and a NameTest otherwise, so 2 * 3, a * b, a*b, count(x) * 2 and count(*) * 2 all multiply while the first '*' of count(*) * 2 selects children.

instances.name: mixed wildcard and multiply fails with a different child count
